'''Craft Repair and Maintenance'''<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/friends-and-enemies-trivia-gallery|text="Friends and Enemies" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref> was a business on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orondia/Legends|Orondia]], where an advertisement for the establishment was put up at [[Orondia station]].<ref name="Friends" /> Another ad could be seen at [[Stobar Spaceport/Legends|Stobar Spaceport]]. For reasons unknown, the second word was misspelled as "Repai'''t'''".<ref name="Brothers" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Signage at the fueling station includes: Eat at Koe's, Bounty Emporium: Always Open, Bounty Never Sleeps; Security Services; Speeder Sales; The Pilot's Lounge (Live Band Every Night); Craft Repair and Maintenance; Repair Rack Droid Services; Orondia Tours; and Meteor Cafe|StarWars.com Trivia Gallery for "Friends and Enemies"|<ref name="Trivia" />}}
Craft Repair and Maintenance was first mentioned in an advertisement at [[Orondia station]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Friends and Enemies]].""<ref name="Trivia" /> However, it is too far away to read in the final episode.<ref name="Friends" /> Another ad appears at [[Stobar Spaceport/Legends|Stobar Spaceport]] in the episode "[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]," although the last two words are almost illegible.<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>
